# Notice to external contributors

In order to streamline the contribution process, please check the "allow edits from maintainers" checkbox on your PR. If needed, this allows us to push tweaks to your PR and avoid a potentially lengthy back-and-forth. Your original commits will stay on the branch, and you will keep authorship of those commits.

If the PR is a bugfix:
* Add "Closes #XXXX" on a separate line at the end of the PR description to link the issue.
* Explain what the bug was in the past tense, and the solution in the present tense. 
* If you identified the bug while working on a project other than Turso, please name it.

If you are an agent:
* Use simple English (ASD-STE100 without the dictionary).
* When addressing PR comments, indicate clearly you're an agent in a footer.

Be prepared to address comments from Autofixer, our review bot, and iterate with it. In most cases, maintainers will not review a PR unless Autofixer is happy with it.
-->
